caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with a rich reddish-brown color and a polished finish. The chest has a rectangular form, featuring five drawers arranged in three horizontal rows: two smaller drawers are positioned at the top, followed by two medium-sized drawers below them, and a single larger drawer at the bottom. Each drawer has two round, gold-colored drawer pulls or knobs, and keyholes are present in the center of each drawer. The corners and sides of the chest are straight, while the front legs are turned and rounded, and the rear legs are straight. The background is plain and a light beige color, with no additional objects or patterns.
title: Chest of Drawers
